title: AgentToolOutcome
description: Content-safe projection of a governed tool execution result for agent consumption. Fields are deterministically derived from ToolRuntimeResult plus registered tool contract metadata plus bounded recovery-policy lookup.

status.description: Canonical lifecycle status preserved from ToolRuntimeStatus.value. Currently recognized values: completed, cached, refused, failed, timed_out, skipped, degraded. Unknown future values are permitted for forward compatibility.

answer_kind.description: Explicit classification of the tool answer for the model: positive, negative_no_match, degraded, refused, execution_failure. A refused tool is distinct from a failed execution; a no_match is a valid negative investigation result.

git_summary_hash.description: SHA256 hash of a bounded git summary when available. Preserves bounded metadata reference without expanding raw output inline.

investigation_outcome.description: Investigation-specific outcome when the tool is a read-only investigation: no_match, match_found, incomplete, stale_context.
